div.head: Quadr Arg 11
div.ab: Hinc sunt illæ leges, illa pacis federa, quo semper Angligenarum corda suspirant et modis optant omnibus, quicquid suspecta dominorum commenta nouitent et raro boni completa promissio.
div.note: New row (October 2026): Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 533 (two independent readings of the page images, differences settled against the page)

note.seg: also eine Verfassung, nicht ein Codex Eadwards. Vgl. CHn cor. 13; u. 27
thus a constitution, not a code of Eadward’s. Cf. CHn cor. 13; below 27
here the people of Anglo-Saxon descent
die seigneurs Französischer Abkunft; vgl. u. S. 543<sup>a</sup>
the seigneurs of French descent; cf. below p. 543<sup>a</sup>
d. h. die Politik, Rechtsherstellung zu versprechen, mit [zu] seltener Erfüllung; derselbe Sinn wie das was pietatis recordatione preparatur 12
i.e. the policy of promising the restoration of law, with [too] rare fulfilment; the same sense as that which pietatis recordatione preparatur 12

div.ab: Hence come those laws, those covenants of peace, for which the hearts of the English always sigh and long by every means, whatever innovations the suspect devices of lords may make, and the promise of good is rarely fulfilled [?].
